competition.title: DOE GEMS: Geothermal Exploration with Machine Learning for Subsurface Fault Discovery
competition.metric: Distance-Weighted Tversky Index (alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel, known catalogue masked pixel-exact)

fleet_progression.key_lesson: Established shared LOQO hide-and-recover evaluator (`gems57`), exact 300 m metric kernel, and zero-NaN export contract; severely under-emitted dot budget (8,192 dots -> massive beta=0.8 FN penalty).
Proved off-catalogue pre-Quaternary SGMC bedrock contacts live predominantly in steep mountain cores rather than active Quaternary geothermal basins (`IMP_TP = 777.6`).
Over-weighted regional hydrothermal/spring plumes without 1D fault-scarp localization (`B'' = 0.07220`), placing broad diffuse clusters away from discrete fault traces.
2D CNN spatial receptive fields overfit 3-quadrant training layouts and emitted thick multi-pixel bands penalized by `alpha=0.2 * FP`.
First multi-line corroborated scarp + thermal anomaly surface (`Instrument A HOLDOUT-DTI = 0.06542`), still un-spaced along centerlines.
1-pixel skeleton thinning jumped +0.0678 live (`0.1922 -> 0.2600`, `HOLDOUT-DTI = 0.09189`), proving 1D trace geometry is essential under the 300 m Tversky kernel.

Introduced 38-feature multi-physics HGB + 2D 300 m submodular coverage, EXCEPT (1) diluted positives with mountain SGMC contacts (`basin% = 49.4%`), (2) zeroed network features, and (3) suffered the 3.13x 2D-blob submodular bias (`9.380 vs 3.000`).
Added heat-flow & scarp-radius refinements on 1D skeletonized traces (`0.2600 -> 0.2707 / 0.2710`).
#2 live fleet score: Anderson fault mechanics + spaced 1D trace dots (`B'' = 0.12954`).

#1 live fleet score (`0.2778`): ~300 m strided dots along 1D piedmont fault ridges (`1.67x` Tversky TP/FP efficiency, `56.0%` basin share, `B'' = 0.12769`), limited by shallow linear feature scoring, uncalibrated SI units, quantized u8 DEMs, and zero elastic fault-network / Radon gap-bridging.

Unifies SI-calibrated 3D magnetic/gravity tilt phases, non-linear sqrt 1m LiDAR wash cancellation, 13-channel float32 10m DEM + chi knickpoints, 12-azimuth Radon phase locking, Byerlee 3D crustal stress + 7,279 heat-flow boreholes + GDR #1391 springs, self-masked LOCO-Quat elastic network propagation, zero-shift Stage-2 Radon gap-bridging, and 1D transverse ridge 200 m submodular Tversky packing (`HOLDOUT-DTI = 0.13509` vs `D28 = 0.09189` and `H33_loqo = 0.04306`; `B'' = 0.14399` #1 across all 274 fleet rasters).
